Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Email and Cloud Services" as it appears in the following examples.
['Your mailbox has exceeded the storage limit 1 GB, which is defined by the administrator, you are running at 99.8 gigabytes, you can not send or receive new messages until you re-validate your mailbox.', 'This is the last notice to inform you as of 30 - Aug - 2016 that you have not yet updated your iCloud ID information.', 'This is the last notice to inform you as of 18 - Sep - 2016 that you have not yet updated your iTunes ID details.', 'Facebook Team sent you a message on Facebook...', 'There are a total of 50 messages awaiting your response.', 'Facebook Service sent you a message.', 'AOL MAIL DEAR ISOBELANDGUY@AOL.COM, KINDLY CLICK ON UPDATE TO COMPLETE THE PROCESS.', 'In order to ensure your account stays secure we require you to unlock your Apple ID below.', "We have tried to contact you on two previous occasions with reference to the European Commissions EID service Regulation (EU) N910/2014 that requires us 'Google Inc' to inspect the authenticity of Google members in Europe.", 'We are migrating all email accounts into Outlook Web App 2017 and as such all active Account Holder are to verify and Log in for the upgrade and migration to take effect now.', 'your Columbia University E-mail Account will be cut off and email service will be discontinued', "Kindly View the document I uploaded for you using Google Drive CLICK HERE and sign in securely to view, It's very Important.", 'This verification further proves the validity of your BT internet account.', 'Kindly confirm that your account is still in use by clicking the validation link below:', 'Welcome to the new outlook web app for Staff', 'Your email account is due for update.', 'Kindly confirm that your account is still in use by clicking the validation link below: Validate E-mail Account', 'Your current webmail will be deactivated soon.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}
